scenario: Host count unstated; model must ask how many devices.
prompt: I need a network for my office with a staff section and a guest section. Not sure how big it needs to be yet.
expected_behaviour: ASK: roughly how many devices in the staff section (and guest section)? The VLAN sizing (required_hosts) depends on it and the model must not invent a count.
why_valuable: Missing host count — a second, distinct ambiguity axis from oc-014 (sites) and oc-015 (addressing).
